_readme: Known findings owned by someone else, so the build stays green while they fix them. Each entry needs an owner and reason. Delete an entry when its data is fixed (check-directory.mjs prints a note for entries no longer needed). New findings are NOT covered and fail the build.

a-url.reason: Everflow compact tracking URL does not support per-product deep links (url/deeplink/destination params ignored, Nov 27, 2026). Food cards share uid=22, generator cards share uid=23, and water/go-bag/brand cards share the main link. Query strings are stripped by destination(), so they look like one URL. Keep until Ready Alliance provides direct links.

Harvest Right iDev deep links are not enabled (idevaffiliate.php?id=4218&url= always redirects to the homepage). The brand card and Countertop 360 card both use the official 4218.html tracking link, which sets the 45-day idev cookie. Keep until Harvest Right enables deep links.
11 Robots International cards use the one referral-code link (no deep link per product yet; program pending). Cards stay distinct products; revisit when per-product links exist.
